messages:
maria_g: Shepherding thread for Predict GA greenlight rollcall. Need final confirmations on SLA wording, pricing examples, docs gaps, canary gating, monitoring SLIs, and support coverage. Please ack or raise items.

lucas_r: SLA: suggested addition 14-day burn-in clause for new deployments before credits apply. Also tightened p99 target to <=300ms for hosted standard. Put draft in staging docs: https://staging.docs/redwood/predict/sla-shepherd

nina_s: Docs: Quickstart + error handling + quota blurb still outstanding. I'll own the error-handling section (429/503 semantics). Can we mark streaming audio as "preview" so it doesn't block GA?

raj_p: Pricing/finops: confirming token-meter with 500-token billing windows. Trial: single 30-day org credit; refunds are handled case-by-case per legal. I'll add billing examples and a short FAQ entry.

ops-bot: Preflight check: infra capacity OK. Canary slot reserved 2024-06-10T14:00Z. Canary cohort template: internal -> dogfood orgs -> 2% tenants -> 20% tenants -> fully open. Autoscaler headroom verified.

maria_g: Monitoring: need SLIs for model-quality drift (per-customer delta on evaluation prompts), token burn rate alerts, latency p95/p99. Proposed alert thresholds: p99 > 400ms OR errors > 0.8% over 10m triggers roll-back decision.

lucas_r: For rollback: add automated switch to quantized-fallback model and notification to #incidents + create incident with tag predict-ga. Who owns the automated action? @ops-bot or infra runbook?

ops-bot: Suggested action implemented in staging runbook: automated fallback uses canary routing rule -> switch model -> post summary to #incidents. Manual approval required to flip back.

nina_s: Docs gap: quota/overage blurb draft: "If you exceed monthly quota requests return HTTP 429 with X-Quota-Reset and X-Quota-Remaining headers. Contact sales to increase quotas." Will land in staging tonight.

raj_p: Billing example to include: per-1k-token charge and sample invoice lines. Also note Dedicated migration path: pro-rate committed capacity and open ticket to sales ops.

maria_g: Legal outstanding item: specific language for trial credit and refunds. I've pinged legal; expect answer by EOD. If legal objects, we'll delay GA by 24h.

lucas_r: CI smoke snippet for docs: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/predict -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' | jq '.status == "ok"'
``` asserts true + HTTP 200. We'll run this every 5m against canary.

nina_s: Support coverage: I'll be primary for first 48h post-GA. Need at least one PST-evening backup. Any volunteers?

raj_p: I can slot evenings for week1. Also will monitor billing metrics for unusual spikes.

maria_g: Launch owners summary: maria_g (SLA/docs/legal follow-up), lucas_r (infra/runbooks/monitoring), nina_s (docs/support), raj_p (pricing/finops). If legal approves trial language by EOD and no other blocks, I'm calling this rollcall green.

ops-bot: Final readiness checklist: docs=staging, sla=draft, infra=capacity-OK, smoke=scheduled, support=coverage-confirmed. All green except legal.

maria_g: Thanks all. I'll update thread when legal confirms. If we go green, I'll post ship notice and schedule canary per ops-bot slot. :shipit:
